# Lukin Center for Psychotherapy

> A family-run psychotherapy practice with 7 New Jersey locations offering evidence-based mental health treatment including therapy, psychiatric services, and specialized evaluations.

Lukin Center serves individuals, couples, families, and adolescents across Northern New Jersey with licensed psychologists and psychiatrists. The practice specializes in multiple evidence-based treatment modalities and maintains a collaborative, integrated approach to mental health care.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Evidence-based treatment
- Anxiety and depression
- Couples therapy
- Child and adolescent therapy
- EMDR
- Medication management
- Neuropsychological evaluations
- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT)
- Parent-Child Interaction Therapy (PCIT)
- SPACE therapy
- Northern New Jersey locations
- Mental health services

## Core Information

- [Lukin Center for Psychotherapy | Therapy & Mental Health in NJ](https://www.lukincenter.com): Homepage for Lukin Center, a psychotherapy practice with 7 NJ locations offering evidence-based therapy services.
- [About The Lukin Center for Psychotherapy in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/about): About page describing Lukin Center's family-run practice, mission, and evidence-based treatment approach.
- [Meet Our Clinicians | Lukin Center for Psychotherapy](https://www.lukincenter.com/about/meet-our-doctors): Directory of licensed psychologists and psychotherapists including Drs. Lukin, Meyer, and Milani.
- [Meet Our Care Coordination Team | Lukin Center for Psychotherapy](https://www.lukincenter.com/meet-our-administrative-staff): Profiles of care coordination and administrative staff supporting therapy services across NJ locations.

## Treatment Modalities

- [How We Treat | Lukin Center for Psychotherapy](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat): Overview of treatment modalities including CBT, DBT, EFT, EMDR, PCIT, and medication management.
- [Evidence Based Psychotherapy | Lukin Center for Psychotherapy](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/psychotherapy): Guide to psychotherapy techniques and modalities including CBT and DBT at Lukin Center.
- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/cognitive-behavioral-therapy): Educational resource on CBT techniques for managing negative emotions and unwanted behaviors.
- [Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) in New Jersey | Lukin Center](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/dialectical-behavioral-therapy): Guide to DBT for emotional regulation and stress management across age groups in NJ.
- [Acceptance & Commitment Therapy (ACT) in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/acceptance-commitment-therapy): Detailed guide to ACT therapy, a mindfulness-based approach for anxiety and depression.
- [Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) Therapy & Treatment in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/eye-movement-desensitization-reprocessing): Guide to EMDR, an evidence-backed therapy for trauma treatment and healing.
- [Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/emotionally-focused-therapy): Information on EFT for couples therapy and relationship intimacy building in Northern NJ.

## Specialized Services

- [Parent-Child Interaction Therapy (PCIT) in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/parent-child-interaction-therapy): Information on PCIT for parenting skills and child behavior management in Northern NJ.
- [SPACE Therapy in New Jersey for Child Anxiety Treatment](https://www.lukincenter.com/supportive-parenting-for-anxious-childhood-emotions-space): Guide to SPACE therapy, a parent-focused approach for child anxiety and OCD.
- [Medication Management & Psychiatry in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/medication-management): Information on psychiatric services and medication management by MDs and DNPs at Lukin Center.
- [Neuropsychological Evaluations & Neuropsychology in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/how-we-treat/neuropsych-evaluations): Guide to neuropsych evaluations for cognitive testing and personalized treatment planning.

## Patient Services by Demographics

- [Who We Treat | Lukin Center for Psychotherapy](https://www.lukincenter.com/who-we-treat): Overview of patient demographics and therapy services for individuals, couples, families, and teens.
- [Individual Therapy in New Jersey](https://www.lukincenter.com/who-we-treat/individual-therapy): Guide to individual therapy services including CBT and DBT for mental health improvement.
- [Couples Therapy in NJ, Relationship & Marriage Counseling](https://www.lukincenter.com/who-we-treat/couples-counseling): Information on couples therapy and marriage counseling for relationship improvement in NJ.
- [Child & Adolescent Therapy in New Jersey | Lukin Center](https://www.lukincenter.com/who-we-treat/child-adolescents): Guide to therapy services for children and teens addressing behavioral and mental health issues.
